scoring_justification: Per-trial raw bests are not in the output contract; only reported summary statistics are available. Comparing these against paper-reported reference values with tolerant threshold-or-better logic is adequate.

steps.tolerance: Relative decay up to 0.5; zero std case uses absolute tolerance 1e-6

hidden_assets.purpose: Gold reference values for each function mean and standard deviation
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Values are verbatim paper-reported results for the TPSO algorithm on benchmark functions; hiding them ensures the agent cannot copy without reproducing

outputs.description: Reproduced benchmark results of the TPSO algorithm on seven high-dimensional test functions. The mean and std must meet or exceed the paper-reported performance.

output_contract.notes: The agent must run 25 independent trials per function to compute the statistics. The hidden checker compares the reported mean and std for each function against hidden gold values using a relative tolerance that accepts equal or better performance.
